review.description: Senior code review — correctness, security, perf, edge cases
review.template:
Review the following code as a senior engineer. Check for:
- Correctness and logic errors
- Security vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10)
- Performance issues
- Backwards compatibility
- Edge cases and error handling
- Naming clarity and code design

Be specific and actionable. Reference line numbers where relevant.

$ARGUMENTS

commit.description: Generate a conventional commit message for staged changes
commit.template:
Generate a conventional commit message for the current staged changes.

Follow the Conventional Commits spec:
  type(scope): short description

Allowed types: feat, fix, chore, refactor, test, docs, style, perf, ci, build
- Keep the subject line under 72 characters
- Use imperative mood ("add" not "added")
- Add a body if the change is non-trivial, explaining *why* not *what*
- Note any breaking changes with BREAKING CHANGE: in the footer

Output only the commit message, no commentary.

pr.description: Write a PR description from the current git diff
pr.template:
Write a pull request description based on the current git diff.

Structure:
## Summary
What changed and why (2-4 sentences, concrete not generic).

## Key Changes
- Bullet points of notable changes

## Testing
How to verify this works.

## Breaking Changes
List any breaking changes, or write "None".

$ARGUMENTS

arch.description: Architecture analysis — layers, coupling, improvement suggestions
arch.template:
Analyze the architecture of this codebase.

Identify:
- Layer boundaries and whether they are respected
- Dependency direction (is it pointing inward?)
- Coupling hotspots and circular dependencies
- Violations of clean / layered architecture
- Concrete, prioritized improvement suggestions

Be specific about file paths and patterns you observe.

$ARGUMENTS
